LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Enabled_Tip: Turn off to restore the unmodified vanilla world map immediately. This setting adds no save data.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Background_Tip: Place a compact translucent nameplate behind each label.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Outline_Tip: Outline label text for contrast over bright terrain.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Displaced: Keep labels that cannot fit under their icon
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Displaced_Tip: When two names collide, Faction Lens can move one further down and draw a connector line back to the icon it belongs to. Off by default: a name that cannot sit directly beneath its own icon is hidden instead, which keeps a crowded world map readable.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_PlayerPriority: Give your own colony names first claim
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_PlayerPriority_Tip: When names compete for the same space, your own colonies are placed first so theirs are never the ones dropped. Most useful with several colonies, when the name is all that tells them apart. Turn off to let every name compete equally.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Legend_Tip: Draws a small key on the world map showing which colour corresponds to which relationship.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Other_Tip: Includes compatible modded world objects whose ownership is meaningful.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Settlements_Tip: Label permanent faction bases: the settlements you can trade with, caravan to, or be raided from.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Sites_Tip: Label temporary world locations such as quest sites, which disappear once they are resolved or expire.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Colorblind_Tip: Use an Okabe-Ito-derived palette with distinct luminance and hue.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Reset_Tip: Restores every Faction Lens setting, including all six relationship colours, to its default.
LanguageData.FactionLens_Settings_Color_Tip: Changes preview here immediately and apply to an open world map without reloading.
